clue.text: You'd hope fast gets broken with this variable dish

explanation.surface: Someone ending a fast hopes the meal will be a dish that changes from one day to the next.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as a whole cryptic description, but the first three words are exactly the twelve letters needed. 'Fast gets broken' also hints at breakfast.
explanation.definitionFit: Restaurants offer a rotating soup whose recipe changes daily, so it is a dish that varies.

clue.text: Painter has mouth turned up — it's nothing to cry about
